title: Armor Resistance
description: A Balanced PvP Oriented Mod That Adds A New Attribute To Netherite Armor!
body:
# Armor Resistance

This Is A Netherite **Addon / Mod** Which Introduces A New Attribute To Netherite Armor.

## General Information

People Always Wonder Why Minecraft Won't Tweak Armor Despite Many Requests On Doing So. Whether It's Enderite Or Any Armor Buffs. Well, I Did Exactly That.

I Am Part Of The Minecraft **1.9+** PvP Community & I Created A Mod That Not Only Helps Counter Extremely High Burst Damage From Weapons Such As The Mace, But Also Keeps Combat Balanced, Unpredictable, And Exciting.

**This Mod Is Best Used In SMPs, Hardcore Worlds, And PvP-Focused Servers.**

## Core Information About The Mod

- -     - -     - -     - -     - -

### What Is Armor Resistance?

Armor Resistance Is A New Attribute Added To Netherite Armor.

Unlike Armor Points, Toughness, Or Protection Enchantments, Armor Resistance Is Checked **Before Any Vanilla Damage Reduction Calculations Occur.**

When Activated, Armor Resistance Can:

- Completely Negate Incoming Damage
- Completely Negate Armor Durability Loss

However, It Is **Not Guaranteed To Activate.**

Armor Resistance Uses A Conditional Chance-Based System Designed To Counter Extremely High Damage Attacks Rather Than Everyday Combat.

---

### How Do I Obtain Armor Resistance Armor?

Armor Resistance Netherite Armor Can Only Be Obtained From Piglin Brutes.

Piglin Brutes Have A Chance To Spawn Wearing Special Armor Resistance Netherite Armor:

- 4% Chance For 1 Piece
- 3% Chance For 2 Pieces
- 2% Chance For 3 Pieces
- 1% Chance For A Full Set

To Obtain It, Right Click A Piglin Brute With A Netherite Scrap For A Single Piece.

Armor Resistance Armor:

- Can Spawn With Vanilla Netherite Enchantments
- Has A 100% Drop Chance
- Cannot Be Crafted
- Cannot Be Upgraded
- Cannot Be Modified In Survival

---

### Armor Resistance Values

Each Armor Piece Contributes Resistance Points:

| Piece | Resistance |
|---------|---------|
| Helmet | 1 |
| Chestplate | 4 |
| Leggings | 2 |
| Boots | 1 |

A Full Set Provides:

**R = 8 Total Armor Resistance**

**R** Represents The Combined Armor Resistance Value Of All Equipped Armor Pieces.

---

### How Does It Work?

Armor Resistance Activates **Before Armor Points, Toughness, Protection Enchantments, Resistance Effects, And Other Vanilla Damage Reduction Mechanics.**

#### Base Activation Chance

Base Chance Is Calculated Using:

```text
Base Chance (%) = R × 10
```

Examples:

- R = 1 → 10%
- R = 5 → 50%
- R = 8 → 80%
- R = 12 → 120%
- R = 48 → 480%

Values Above 100% Are Raw Values And May Be Reduced By Anti-Abuse Scaling.

#### Damage Requirement

Armor Resistance Only Has A Chance To Activate If Incoming Damage Falls Within This Range:

```text
Minimum Damage = R + 3
Maximum Damage = (R + 3) + 8
```

Example:

```text
R = 8

Minimum Damage = 11
Maximum Damage = 19
```

A Full Set (R = 8) Can Only Roll Armor Resistance Against Attacks Dealing Between **11 And 19 Hearts Of Damage.**

If The Damage Requirement Is Not Met:

- Armor Resistance Does Not Roll
- Armor Resistance Is Completely Ignored
- Vanilla Damage Processing Continues Normally

This Prevents Armor Resistance From Affecting Normal Combat While Allowing It To Counter Devastating Burst Damage.

#### Durability Requirement

Armor Resistance Also Checks How Much Durability Would Be Lost.

```text
Minimum Durability Loss = R + 2
Maximum Durability Loss = (R + 2) + R
```

Example:

```text
R = 8

Minimum Durability Loss = 10
Maximum Durability Loss = 18
```

If The Damage Requirement Passes But The Durability Requirement Fails:

```text
Final Chance = Base Chance ÷ 1.5
```

Decimals Are Ignored.

Example:

```text
80 ÷ 1.5 = 53%
```

#### Activation Result

If Armor Resistance Successfully Activates:

- Negates 100% Of Incoming Damage
- Negates 100% Of Durability Loss
- Prevents Health Loss
- Prevents Armor Durability Loss

If The Roll Fails:

- Vanilla Damage Processing Continues Normally

---

### Creative Mode & Attribute Support

Although Armor Resistance Cannot Be Modified In Survival, It Is Implemented As A Real Attribute.

This Means Developers, Map Makers, And Server Owners Can Modify Armor Resistance Using Vanilla Commands Such As:

```mcfunction
/attribute
```

Example:

```text
Helmet = 12
Chestplate = 12
Leggings = 12
Boots = 12

R = 48
```

---

### Anti-Abuse Scaling

To Prevent Immortality And Command Abuse, Armor Resistance Uses Automatic Diminishing Returns.

If:

```text
R > 8
```

Then:

```text
Final Chance = Final Chance ÷ 1.5
```

If:

```text
R > 10
```

Then:

```text
Final Chance = Final Chance ÷ (1.5 × Number Of Armor Pieces Worn)
```

Example:

```text
R = 48

Base Chance = 480%

480 ÷ 7.5 ≈ 64%
```

This Ensures That Even Extremely High Values Remain Balanced.

More Resistance Does Not Mean Infinite Survivability.

---

### Balance & Design Philosophy

Armor Resistance Was Designed Around Several Goals:

- Counter Extreme Burst Damage
- Preserve Vanilla Netherite Balance
- Prevent Immortality
- Keep Combat Skill-Based
- Reward Luck Without Guaranteeing Survival

Because Armor Resistance Uses Random Chance, Players Can Never Reliably Depend On It.

Even A Full Set Can Fail To Activate.

This Creates Intense Moments During Combat And Makes Every Fight Less Predictable.

---

### Technical Notes

- Compatible With Vanilla Enchantments
- Multiplayer Friendly
- No New Ores
- No New Dimensions
- No New Crafting Recipes
- No New Armor Tiers
- No Changes To Vanilla Netherite Stats
- Armor Resistance Is The Only Added Mechanic
- Supports Vanilla Attribute Commands
- Includes Automatic Anti-Abuse Scaling
- Full Survival Set (R = 8) Is The Intended Balance Point

---

### Recommended Usage

✔ SMPs  
✔ Hardcore Worlds  
✔ PvP Servers  
✔ Lifesteal-Style Servers  
✔ Survival , Multiplayer

---

# Warnings

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This Mod Could Get You Banned If Used In PvP Or SMP Based Servers As It Is Modifying Vanilla Minecraft & Providing You With An Advantage That Other Users Do Not Have Access To. Use At Your Own Risk When Playing Multiplayer.

</details>
